observations: The synthetic query was entered before choosing the combined candidate, then preserved across draft selection, selection entry, explicit apply and return.
Draft selection and selection entry did not alter the applied H appearance; selection made the product inert.
Explicit apply rendered Original 46px classification tabs and the 10px input frame together, using one root, one classification tablist and one search input.
Clear search restored two rows. Completed navigation hid search; one browser Back returned to pending with both appearances. Forward was not tested.
Two frozen baseline recipe JSONs each restored only the draft, then manual apply retained their original tabs-only or search-only appearance.
Owned browser and preview resources closed with preview exit zero.
browser.probeCorrection: An initial inert probe targeted an outer QA root; a subsequent read of the input inert ancestor confirmed true. Both observations were retained privately; no product change or acceptance retry was involved.
